fit_semantics: one residual-memory construction for each origin x observed/shuffled arm; no estimator refit
donors: present-stream rows, cycles 56 through origin, finite exact float64 impact_load

retrieval.text: reuse frozen A02 target-free TF-IDF vectorizer at the same origin; extract vectorizer state only
retrieval.matching: exact equality of parsed float64 impact_load; no binning, rounding, or quantile edges
retrieval.geometry: search all same-impact donors for positive cosine top32, stable descending cosine then source row

residual: threat_rank minus final-mapped R06 OOF prediction using the frozen strictly-earlier source cutoff

shuffle.strata: exact donor cycle x exact impact_load x fixed R06 OOF prediction decile
shuffle.traversal: ascending cycle, impact_load, decile, and source row

fallback: exact R06 for missing stream, missing impact, or fewer than five positive-cosine same-impact neighbors

preflight.coverage_denominator: present-stream queries in each declared W4, W6, and E67 H12 view

source_boundaries.query targets: read only after all four durable bundles and independent integrity checks

no_rescue: preflight failure skips all task fits; no threshold, bin, seed, or recipe search
